agreements.name: Privacy Policy
agreements.title: Privacy Policy
body: This Privacy Policy explains how Transcard Payments, LLC collects, uses and shares personal information when you receive a payment through SMART Disburse.

We collect the details you give us, such as your name, date of birth, Social Security Number, address, phone number and email address, to verify your identity, issue your Virtual Card and meet our legal and regulatory obligations.

We share your information only with the issuing Bank, the company that sent you the payment, and service providers that help us run the Service, and only as needed for those purposes. We do not sell your personal information.
We keep your information for as long as needed to provide the Service and to meet legal requirements. You can ask us to access or correct your information by contacting sales@transcard.com.
We use industry-standard safeguards, including encryption in transit and at rest, to protect your information.

agreements.name: E-Sign Consent
agreements.title: Consent to Electronic Communications (E-Sign)
body: By accepting, you agree to receive disclosures, notices, agreements and other communications about your Virtual Card electronically rather than on paper.
Electronic communications may be shown on screen during this process or sent to the email address you provided. They have the same legal effect as if they were printed and signed by hand.
You can withdraw your consent at any time by contacting sales@transcard.com. Withdrawing consent may mean we can no longer issue or service your Virtual Card electronically.
To access electronic communications you need a device with an internet connection, a current web browser and software that can open PDF files.
Please keep your email address up to date so you continue to receive communications about your payment.
